title: AIO Agent
shortDescription: Give tasks to AI, follow progress and review results in one workspace.
fullDescription:
AIO Agent is your AI workspace. Describe what you need in the main chat, follow task progress and results, and add instructions whenever you need.

• Main chat: submit tasks, follow progress, review results and continue related work.
• Task browser: see the pages used by the AI, take over when needed, then return control.
• Workspace: access task files, generated documents and reference materials.
• Voice input: turn speech into a draft you can review before sending.
• Google sign-in: sign in or register with Google. First-time registration requires an invitation code; existing accounts can sign in directly.
• Account and content support: report an AI response, or request deletion of your account and associated data through Account & privacy.

The interface supports English, Spanish, Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese. You can choose your language in Settings.

First-time registration requires an invitation code. An internet connection is required. Tasks depend on the AIO Agent service and configured AI providers.

AI responses may be inaccurate and provide general information only. AIO Agent is not a medical device and does not diagnose, treat or prevent medical conditions. Consult a qualified doctor for medical advice, and qualified professionals for legal or investment advice.
